name: Slideshow files
description:
1. Added a full-screen **slide show** overlay (`FileSlideShow.vue`) to the file browser, opened from a new toolbar button in `FileExplorer.vue`, with the active file preview rendered by `FileViewer` in a new header-collapsed `slideMode`.
2. Built the carousel: the active slide occupies **80% × 80%** of the slides area with smaller, faded neighbours behind it, animated with a 500ms transition when a thumbnail or side slide is clicked.
3. Centered the bottom thumbnail strip (`mx-auto w-max` track, still scrollable when it overflows) and restyled its tiles with the explorer's **preview-mode** markup — image, video first frame, PDF/audio badge, icon + type-label fallback, and name/size overlay.
4. Made the `FileViewer` header reachable in slide mode via a clickable, keyboard-accessible top bar (`role="button"`, `aria-expanded`) that expands/collapses the full header on demand.
5. Added a **Fit / Full** toggle (header button, `F` key, double-click) that expands the active slide to the whole slides area while neighbours animate out of view.

/**

 *
 * `GET /api/files/read` and `POST /api/files/diff` are the expensive calls of the
 * editor / diff views. They are plain HTTP requests and stay that way: the
 * Socket.IO variant (`codx-junior-file-read` / `codx-junior-file-diff`) was
 * tried and measured slower, because the answer has to be broadcast and matched
 * by `request_id` instead of being returned to the caller.
 *
 * What keeps them cheap is the layer around the request, not the transport:
 *
 *  - an identical `read` / `diff` is served from the short-term cache for a few
 *    seconds (a diff is keyed by a hash of its content),
 *  - a caller arriving while the same request is running waits for it instead of
 *    starting a second one,
 *  - **different** reads and diffs are queued (`files:read` / `files:diff`, one
 *    at a time) so a re-rendered diff panel cannot flood the backend,
 *  - `force: true` bypasses the entry for an explicit refresh.
 *
 * Keys are built from the **normalized** path: `./src/a.js`, `src/a.js` and
 * `src//a.js` are one file, so they share an entry — and a write through any of
 * those spellings invalidates all of them.

request.content: codx-junior file browser (`src/components/filebrowser/`): `FileViewer.vue` takes a `params` prop (`{ filePath }`) and now a `slideMode` boolean that collapses its header (used by `FileSlideShow.vue`). `FileExplorer` entries expose absolute `entry.file_path`; previews/downloads use `$api.files.getFilePreviewUrl(path)` / `getFileDownloadUrl(path)`. `read()` goes through a `files:read` queue (concurrency 1) — do not mount many `FileViewer`s at once. Components follow the split `<script setup>` (imports only) + `<script>` (props/data/computed/watch/methods) pattern, Tailwind only, no semicolons, no `<style>` blocks. Slide show overlay is full-screen `fixed inset-0 z-[60]`.
